name: Thel Lual Akuei
request:
Subject: Prayer Request - Financial, Education, and Health

Dear Apostle MJ Manyiel,  
Greetings in the name of Jesus Christ.

My name is Marko Thel Lual Akuei from Juba. I am writing to humbly submit my prayer requests to you.

About my family background:
I am the only son of my mother. We were 8 children, but unfortunately 4 have passed away. We now remain 4. I was supposed to be the second born, but my elder sister died at a young age. So I am now the first born to my mother.  

My father later married a second wife and they had 7 children - 1 son and 6 daughters. Two have also passed away, and 4 girls and 1 boy remain.  
He married a third wife, but she left without having children.  
He married a fourth wife, and they have 2 sons and 1 daughter.

My prayer requests are:

1.  Financial Breakthrough
    As the first born in the entire family of Lual Akuei, I carry the burden to help lift my younger brothers and sisters out of poverty. I pray for God to open doors of financial blessing so I can support my family.
2.  Education
    My father is no longer able to afford my school fees due to lack of resources. I pray for God to provide sponsorship, scholarship, or helpers so I can complete my studies and have a better future.
3.  Health and Life
    In every human life, God is the most important. Despite the hardships, I pray for good health, protection, and deliverance. Pastor, my life is currently at risk and I am going through a lot of pain. I ask for prayer for healing, peace, and God’s covering over my life.
4.  Purpose and Guidance
    I also pray that God will direct my steps, give me wisdom, and use my life to be a blessing to my family and generation.

Pastor, please stand with me in prayer. I believe God will answer through your prayers.

Thank you and God bless you.  
Yours in Christ,
Marko Thel Lual Akuei 
Juba, South Sudan
